attributes.name: Speak with Dead
attributes.powers: When a character at your location defeats a monster, display this card next to your location. While displayed, add 1 die to your Intelligence and Wisdom checks at your location.
attributes.recharge: When the location is closed, if you do not have the Divine skill, banish it; otherwise, attempt a Divine 6 check. If you succeed, recharge this card; if you fail, discard it.
